subject: Night support coverage request: temporary backfill & SLA adjustment
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@octaveanalytics.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: eng-ops@octaveanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Night support coverage request: temporary backfill & SLA adjustment

Hi Dylan,

We're running into a hiring delay on our SRE team and anticipate a 3-week gap in overnight coverage (US Pacific nights). During that window Octave will still require P1/P2 support but we'd like to request a temporary adjustment to the P2 response SLA and also understand what your on-call backfill options are.

Current ask: would Redwood approve a short-term P2 response window increase from 2 hours to 4 hours (P1 unchanged), and provide a documented escalation ladder and dedicated on-call backfill plan while our hires start? We expect the gap to start 2026-11-01 and run through 2026-11-21.

We can share a compact incident runbook and have a point-of-contact for the night shift. If there are credits or a formal waiver needed, please let me know required sign-off and timeline.

Thanks,
Sarah Kim
Head of Platform Ops
Octave Analytics

Attachments: Octave internal incident matrix (not attached here)
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@octaveanalytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Night support coverage request: temporary backfill & SLA adjustment

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear outline. We can support you here, but will need an agreed temporary policy and a short operational plan that defines on-call handoffs and the escalation ladder.

Quick summary of what I propose:
- Duration: 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-21 (as requested).
- SLAs: P1 unchanged (1 hour response target, same escalation). P2 adjusted to a 4-hour response target for the temporary window.
- Credits: pro-rated service credit for reduced P2 performance during the waiver window; we will draft numbers after we confirm expected volume.
- Backfill: Redwood will provide a dedicated night responder pool (rotating) for P1/P2 triage and will escalate to Octave on-call if incident looks product-impacting.
- Escalation ladder: Redwood night responder -> Redwood Tier 2 on-call -> Laurel (Support Lead) -> Octave on-call (if customer escalation required).

Action items:
1) Laura, can you confirm we can staff the dedicated night pool for the requested dates and prepare the waiver PDF?
2) Sarah, please share the incident runbook and point-of-contact for nights so we can align the playbook.
3) Ben, I'll need a quick note on credit calculation and whether this requires Sales sign-off on the order.

I'll attach a draft backfill plan in the next update.

— Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Night support coverage request: temporary backfill & SLA adjustment

Dylan — we can staff a small night pool for Octave but need a few clarifications to operationalize cleanly:

- Roster: recommend 2x night responders per shift with a single named owner per night to reduce context-switching.
- Handoffs: we need the 1) night POC name + mobile, 2) incident runbook link, and 3) expected daily event volume (alerts/day).
- Escalation ladder (operational detail):
  * Night responder (Redwood) — initial triage and short-term mitigation.
  * Redwood Tier 2 (on-call) — full incident ownership if beyond night responder scope.
  * Incident Commander (Octave POC) — engaged for customer-impacting incidents.
  * Exec escalation (both sides) — reserved for Sev1 business-impacting incidents.

Operational constraints: if alert volume > 6/day consistently we will need to expand the night pool or request additional compensation; that should be in the waiver.

I'll prepare the waiver PDF (redwood-sla-waiver-draft.pdf) and a short backfill workbook (octave-backfill-plan.xlsx). Mina — can you help coordinate the runbook ingestion and a short 30-min sync with Octave next week?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Support Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Night support coverage request: temporary backfill & SLA adjustment

Sarah — attached are the two files Laura mentioned: redwood-sla-waiver-draft.pdf and octave-backfill-plan.xlsx. High level:

- Approved temporary SLA: P1 = 1 hour (no change), P2 = 4 hours for 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-21.
- Redwood will staff a 2-person night responder pool per shift for those dates; responders will perform triage and classify incidents.
- Escalation ladder (finalized): Redwood night responder -> Redwood Tier 2 -> Redwood Support Lead (Laura) -> Octave night POC -> Octave on-call engineer -> Exec notification if Sev1 persists beyond 2 hours.
- Credits: we propose a 5% pro-rated service credit applied to the invoice covering the waiver window if P2 targets are missed more than twice in the window; Ben will confirm final CDS calculation.

Next steps:
1) Sarah — sign the waiver (DocuSign link below) or reply with any edits by 2026-10-25 so we can lock staffing.
2) Share the runbook and night POC.
3) Schedule a 30-min operational sync (Laura + Mina + Octave POC + Dylan).
